name: Rowan Katz
life: “I still remember the classroom where my nickname hurt most.” People around the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio know Rowan by a small Thursday habit. Rowan notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I chose that nickname to survive school. Seeing it on bank stationery made me feel sixteen again.
appearance: Rowan has closely cropped salt-and-pepper hair, a strong profile and a little space between the front teeth, and a favorite piece of clothing, a brown corduroy jacket. It usually goes with a small enamel bird on the lapel. When somebody else has the floor, Rowan turns fully toward the person speaking.
personality: Rowan listens for the familiar version of a story and then for the one detail that changes it. Friends bring problems here when they want to be heard twice.
agenda: To let the scholarship use the old nickname with permission.
family: Catherine Leung is Rowan’s second cousin. Rowan chooses whether to use it. Catherine saves a place. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The porch auction*, Catherine says, “I proposed to my second husband in the low chair.”
connections: Howard Poole (trust secretary). Founder and secretary can now meet under the easier childhood name.
